data.assumption: “கடந்த 8 வாரங்கள்” என்பதை நடப்பு வாரம் உட்பட கடைசி 8 calendar weeks என்றும், “capture ஆன GMV” என்பதை UK showrooms-க்கு GBP currency-யில் status captured ஆன payment attempts-ன் amount_minor மொத்தம் என்றும் எடுத்துக்கொண்டேன்.
data.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', pa.business_date)::date AS week_start, SUM(pa.amount_minor) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN countries c ON c.country_code = s.country_code
WHERE pa.is_test = false
  AND o.is_test = false
  AND LOWER(pa.status) = 'captured'
  AND c.country_code = 'GB'
  AND pa.currency = 'GBP'
  AND pa.business_date >= DATE_TRUNC('week', DATE '2026-09-10')::date - INTERVAL '7 weeks'
  AND pa.business_date < DATE_TRUNC('week', DATE '2026-09-10')::date + INTERVAL '1 week'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', pa.business_date)::date
ORDER BY week_start
